# Story 7.10: Tenth story

## Story

As a fixture author,
I want a double-digit story number,
so that lexicographic sorting is detectable: "7.10" < "7.2" as strings, but
7.10 must come LAST.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Given** stories 7.1, 7.2 and 7.10
   **When** they are ordered
   **Then** 7.10 sorts last, not second.
